meaning.zh:
“看起来神采奕奕” 或 “看起来非常出色”。

这个短语起源于早期二十世纪，当时一百万美元被认为是一笔巨款。用这个短语形容一个人，通常是表示这个人看起来非常好，打扮得体、精神饱满、令人印象深刻。在现代社会，这个短语广泛用于夸赞别人的外表或状态。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in the early 20th century when one million dollars was considered a substantial amount of money. Using this phrase to describe a person typically means they look exceptionally good, well-dressed, spirited, and impressive. In modern society, it's widely used to compliment someone's appearance or condition.

lines.en: You look like a million bucks in that dress!
lines.zh: 你穿那条裙子看起来真是神采奕奕！

lines.en: After his vacation, he came back looking like a million dollars.
lines.zh: 度假回来后，他看起来精神焕发。

lines.en: With that new haircut, you look like a million bucks!
lines.zh: 你这个新发型让你看起来精神饱满！
